name: kimi_k3_kda_conv_strided_rows_proj1536_width4
description: Kimi-K3's KDA short convolution, every sequence's tokens back to back: sequence s owns rows cu_seqlens[s]:cu_seqlens[s + 1] of x and slot state_indices[s] of conv_state. Per channel c of the packed q|k|v (c = part * proj + j for x[:, part, j]), the window is conv_state[slot, :, c] (when has_initial_state[s], else width - 1 zeros) then the sequence's inputs; token t's y[t, c] = silu(sum_j weight[c, j] * window[t + j]) in float32, rounded to x's dtype; the window's last width - 1 entries are written back to conv_state[slot, :, c]. q = y[:, :proj], k = y[:, proj:2 * proj], v = y[:, 2 * proj:]. Slots no sequence names are left unchanged.

n_tokens.description: Tokens of every sequence, back to back.

proj.description: Channels of each of q, k and v on this rank.

x.description: The packed q|k|v projection before the convolution: x[t, 0] is q's, x[t, 1] k's, x[t, 2] v's.

weight.description: Each packed channel's taps, the oldest input's first; float32, as vLLM keeps Kimi-K3's.

conv_state.description: The paged convolution state, vLLM's SD layout: per slot, its last width - 1 inputs, oldest first, each a row of every packed channel (vLLM's slot may hold more rows, for speculative decoding: the first width - 1 are these).

has_initial_state.description: Whether each sequence resumes from its slot's state, else from zeros.

cu_seqlens.description: Where each sequence's tokens start, then where the last ends.

sources.content:
"""KDA causal conv1d (width 4) in FlyDSL, one launch.

Each workgroup is one 64-lane wave covering 512 channels (8 contiguous bf16 channels per lane, 16-byte loads and
stores along the channel axis). With few sequences (n_seqs <= MAXS) the grid is n_seqs head blocks then token-aligned
body blocks: body block b loads x rows 8b-3 .. 8b+7 at entry (no dependence on cu_seqlens) and stores every token that
is not among the first 3 of its sequence; head block s computes its sequence's first min(3, seqlen) tokens from the
conv_state slot (or zeros) and writes the state back, so each slot has one owner. With more sequences, chunks are
aligned to sequences (block f(s) + k, f(s) = s + cu[s] // BT, found by binary search) and chunk 0 owns the slot.
The window is kept in registers; y = silu(sum_j w[c, j] * window[t + j]) in fp32, rounded to bf16 (nearest-even).
The taps w are float32, as vLLM keeps Kimi-K3's conv1d weight: each lane reads its 8 channels' 4 taps as 8 x dwordx4.
"""

import functools

import torch

import flydsl.compiler as flyc
import flydsl.expr as fx
from flydsl.expr.typing import Int32, T

from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops
from flydsl._mlir import ir
from flydsl._mlir.dialects import arith as _arith
from flydsl._mlir.dialects import rocdl

RANGE_SAFE = True

BT = 8  # tokens per workgroup
LOG2_BT = 3
MAXS = 16  # sequences resolved by the unrolled search
BSEARCH_STEPS = 24  # binary search depth beyond MAXS (up to 2**24 sequences)
LANES = 64
VEC = 8  # bf16 channels per lane
STRIP = LANES * VEC  # 512 channels per workgroup
SL = 3  # state_len
W = 4
_LOG2E = 1.4426950408889634


def _search_big(cu_r, n_seqs, g):
    i32 = T.i32
    # many sequences: unrolled binary search (f is strictly increasing)
    lo = fx.Int32(0)
    hi = n_seqs
    for _ in fx.range_constexpr(BSEARCH_STEPS):
        mid = (lo + hi) >> 1
        cm = fx.Int32(buffer_ops.buffer_load(cu_r, mid, vec_width=1, dtype=i32))
        live = (hi - lo) > 1
        take = live & (((cm >> LOG2_BT) + mid) <= g)
        drop = live & (((cm >> LOG2_BT) + mid) > g)
        lo = take.select(mid, lo)
        hi = drop.select(mid, hi)
    s = lo
    cs_start = fx.Int32(buffer_ops.buffer_load(cu_r, s, vec_width=1, dtype=i32))
    cs_end = fx.Int32(buffer_ops.buffer_load(cu_r, s + 1, vec_width=1, dtype=i32))
    return s, cs_start, cs_end


def _search_small(cu_r, n_seqs, g):
    i32 = T.i32
    # few sequences: unrolled, independent loads
    cus = []
    for i in fx.range_constexpr(MAXS + 1):
        idx = (n_seqs < i).select(n_seqs, fx.Int32(i)) if i > 0 else fx.Int32(0)
        cus.append(fx.Int32(buffer_ops.buffer_load(cu_r, idx, vec_width=1, dtype=i32)))
    s = fx.Int32(0)
    cs_start = cus[0]
    cs_end = cus[1]
    for i in fx.range_constexpr(1, MAXS):
        fi = (cus[i] >> LOG2_BT) + i
        take = (fx.Int32(i) < n_seqs) & (fi <= g)
        s = take.select(fx.Int32(i), s)
        cs_start = take.select(cus[i], cs_start)
        cs_end = take.select(cus[i + 1], cs_end)
    return s, cs_start, cs_end


@functools.cache
def _launcher(big):
    Vec = fx.Vector

    @flyc.kernel
    def conv_kernel(
        x_ptr: fx.Tensor,
        w_ptr: fx.Tensor,
        cs_ptr: fx.Tensor,
        si_ptr: fx.Tensor,
        hi_ptr: fx.Tensor,
        cu_ptr: fx.Tensor,
        q_ptr: fx.Tensor,
        k_ptr: fx.Tensor,
        v_ptr: fx.Tensor,
        n_seqs: Int32,
        proj_h: Int32,
        sx0: Int32,
        sx1: Int32,
        scs0: Int32,
        scs1: Int32,
        qs0: Int32,
        ks0: Int32,
        vs0: Int32,
        n_tok: Int32,
    ):
        # all *_h offsets/strides are in i32 units (2 bf16)
        i32 = T.i32

        def _rsrc(p):
            return buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource(p, max_size=True)

        x_r = _rsrc(x_ptr)
        w_r = _rsrc(w_ptr)
        cs_r = _rsrc(cs_ptr)
        si_r = _rsrc(si_ptr)
        hi_r = _rsrc(hi_ptr)
        cu_r = _rsrc(cu_ptr)
        q_r = _rsrc(q_ptr)
        k_r = _rsrc(k_ptr)
        v_r = _rsrc(v_ptr)

        tid = fx.thread_idx.x
        g = fx.Int32(fx.block_idx.x)
        py = fx.Int32(fx.block_idx.y)
        part = py // 3
        sub = py - part * 3

        c_in_part_h = sub * (STRIP // 2) + tid * (VEC // 2)  # i32 units inside the part
        c_glob_h = part * proj_h + c_in_part_h  # packed channel, i32 units

        # weights: 8 channels x 4 taps = 32 float32 = 8 x dwordx4 (one channel each; channel 2 * c_glob_h starts at
        # dword 8 * c_glob_h), issued before the search (always in bounds)
        w_raw = []
        for i in fx.range_constexpr(8):
            w_raw.append(buffer_ops.buffer_load(w_r, c_glob_h * 8 + i * 4, vec_width=4, dtype=i32))

        if big:
            # speculative rows -3..BT-1 of chunk g assuming one sequence starting at token 0 (clamped in bounds);
            # used only when that guess is exactly the chunk's window (checked after the search)
            pbase = part * sx1 + c_in_part_h
            spec = []
            for r in fx.range_constexpr(-SL, BT):
                tr = g * BT + r
                tr = (tr < 0).select(fx.Int32(0), tr)
                tr = (tr >= n_tok).select(n_tok - 1, tr)
                spec.append(buffer_ops.buffer_load(x_r, tr * sx0 + pbase, vec_width=4, dtype=i32))

            # ---- find the sequence of virtual block g: the largest s < n_seqs with f(s) = cu[s] // BT + s <= g
            s, cs_start, cs_end = (_search_big if big else _search_small)(cu_r, n_seqs, g)
            f_s = (cs_start >> LOG2_BT) + s
            kch = g - f_s
            seqlen = cs_end - cs_start
            w0 = kch * BT
            active = w0 < seqlen

            is0 = kch == 0
            full = (w0 + BT) <= seqlen

            # weights pre-scaled by -log2(e): the tap sum is then y = -a * log2(e), the exp2 argument
            wf = []
            for i in fx.range_constexpr(8):
                vf = Vec(w_raw[i]).bitcast(fx.Float32)
                for e in fx.range_constexpr(4):
                    wf.append(vf[e] * fx.Float32(-_LOG2E))
            # wf[ch*4 + j]

            xbase = cs_start * sx0 + part * sx1 + c_in_part_h
            row0 = (cs_start + w0) * sx0 + part * sx1 + c_in_part_h

            def _sel(c, a, b):
                return _arith.SelectOp(buffer_ops._unwrap_value(c), buffer_ops._unwrap_value(a),
                                       buffer_ops._unwrap_value(b)).result

            _i32t = ir.IntegerType.get_signless(32)
            _v4t = ir.VectorType.get([4], _i32t)

            out_r = _sel(part == 0, q_r, _sel(part == 1, k_r, v_r))
            os0 = (part == 0).select(qs0, (part == 1).select(ks0, vs0))
            obase = (cs_start + w0) * os0 + c_in_part_h

            def _unpack(raw):
                vx = Vec(raw).bitcast(fx.BFloat16).to(fx.Float32)
                return [vx[e] for e in range(8)]

            def _store_u(val, t):
                buffer_ops.buffer_store(val, out_r, obase + t * os0)

            def _store_g(val, t):
                okt = (w0 + t) < seqlen
                if okt:
                    buffer_ops.buffer_store(val, out_r, obase + t * os0)

            _f32t = ir.F32Type.get()

            _cl = fx.Float32(-_LOG2E)

            def _silu(y):
                # y = -a * log2(e); silu(a) = a / (1 + 2^y) = y / (-(1 + 2^y) * log2(e)), native exp2 and rcp.
                # a << 0: 2^y = inf, rcp(-inf) = -0, result -0 (no NaN); a >> 0: 2^y = 0, result y / C = a
                ex = fx.Float32(rocdl.exp2(_f32t, fx.math.as_ir_value(y)))
                dn = fx.math.fma(ex, _cl, _cl)
                return y * fx.Float32(rocdl.rcp(_f32t, fx.math.as_ir_value(dn)))

            def _load_rows(guarded):
                raws = []
                for r in fx.range_constexpr(BT):
                    off = ((w0 + r) < seqlen).select(row0 + r * sx0, xbase) if guarded else row0 + r * sx0
                    raws.append(buffer_ops.buffer_load(x_r, off, vec_width=4, dtype=i32))
                return raws

            def _tokens(heads, raws, guarded):
                win = [_unpack(heads[0]), _unpack(heads[1]), _unpack(heads[2])]
                for t in fx.range_constexpr(BT):
                    win.append(_unpack(raws[t]))
                    ys = []
                    for e in fx.range_constexpr(8):
                        a = win[0][e] * wf[e * 4 + 0]
                        a = fx.math.fma(win[1][e], wf[e * 4 + 1], a)
                        a = fx.math.fma(win[2][e], wf[e * 4 + 2], a)
                        a = fx.math.fma(win[3][e], wf[e * 4 + 3], a)
                        ys.append(_silu(a))
                    win = win[1:]
                    ov = Vec.from_elements(ys, dtype=fx.Float32).to(fx.BFloat16).bitcast(fx.Int32)
                    (_store_g if guarded else _store_u)(ov.ir_value(), t)

            fast = (kch != 0) & full & ((cs_start + w0) == g * BT)
            if fast:
                _tokens(spec[0:SL], spec[SL:], False)
            else:
              if active:
                  def _rest(guarded):
                      # chunk k >= 1: the head is the 3 x rows before the chunk (inside the sequence)
                      heads = []
                      for r in fx.range_constexpr(SL):
                          heads.append(buffer_ops.buffer_load(x_r, row0 - (SL - r) * sx0, vec_width=4, dtype=i32))
                      raws = _load_rows(guarded)
                      _tokens(heads, raws, guarded)

                  if is0:
                      # chunk 0: head is the conv_state slot (or zeros), then write the state back
                      slot = fx.Int32(buffer_ops.buffer_load(si_r, s, vec_width=1, dtype=i32))
                      hi8 = fx.Int8(buffer_ops.buffer_load(hi_r, s, vec_width=1, dtype=T.i8))
                      hi_nz = hi8 != 0
                      cs_base = slot * scs0 + c_glob_h
                      zero_v = _arith.ConstantOp(_v4t, ir.DenseElementsAttr.get_splat(
                          _v4t, ir.IntegerAttr.get(_i32t, 0))).result
                      raws = _load_rows(True)
                      heads = []
                      for r in fx.range_constexpr(SL):
                          hs = buffer_ops.buffer_load(cs_r, cs_base + r * scs1, vec_width=4, dtype=i32)
                          heads.append(_sel(hi_nz, hs, zero_v))
                      _tokens(heads, raws, True)

                      # ---- state writeback: window positions seqlen .. seqlen+2
                      for i in fx.range_constexpr(SL):
                          wpos = seqlen + i  # window position (window = [3 head | inputs])
                          from_x = wpos >= SL
                          offx = from_x.select(xbase + (wpos - SL) * sx0, xbase)
                          xv = buffer_ops.buffer_load(x_r, offx, vec_width=4, dtype=i32)
                          hv = heads[0]
                          hv = _sel(wpos == 1, heads[1], hv)
                          hv = _sel(wpos == 2, heads[2], hv)
                          nv = _sel(from_x, xv, hv)
                          buffer_ops.buffer_store(nv, cs_r, cs_base + i * scs1)
                  else:
                      if full:
                          _rest(False)
                      else:
                          _rest(True)

        else:

            def _sel(c, a, b):
                return _arith.SelectOp(buffer_ops._unwrap_value(c), buffer_ops._unwrap_value(a),
                                       buffer_ops._unwrap_value(b)).result

            _i32t = ir.IntegerType.get_signless(32)
            _v4t = ir.VectorType.get([4], _i32t)
            _f32t = ir.F32Type.get()
            _cl = fx.Float32(-_LOG2E)

            out_r = _sel(part == 0, q_r, _sel(part == 1, k_r, v_r))
            os0 = (part == 0).select(qs0, (part == 1).select(ks0, vs0))
            pbase = part * sx1 + c_in_part_h

            def _wf():
                wf = []
                for i in fx.range_constexpr(8):
                    vf = Vec(w_raw[i]).bitcast(fx.Float32)
                    for e in fx.range_constexpr(4):
                        wf.append(vf[e] * fx.Float32(-_LOG2E))
                return wf

            def _unpack(raw):
                vx = Vec(raw).bitcast(fx.BFloat16).to(fx.Float32)
                return [vx[e] for e in range(8)]

            def _silu(y):
                ex = fx.Float32(rocdl.exp2(_f32t, fx.math.as_ir_value(y)))
                dn = fx.math.fma(ex, _cl, _cl)
                return y * fx.Float32(rocdl.rcp(_f32t, fx.math.as_ir_value(dn)))

            def _tokens(wf, heads, raws, nt, obase, oks):
                win = [_unpack(heads[0]), _unpack(heads[1]), _unpack(heads[2])]
                for t in fx.range_constexpr(nt):
                    win.append(_unpack(raws[t]))
                    ys = []
                    for e in fx.range_constexpr(8):
                        a = win[0][e] * wf[e * 4 + 0]
                        a = fx.math.fma(win[1][e], wf[e * 4 + 1], a)
                        a = fx.math.fma(win[2][e], wf[e * 4 + 2], a)
                        a = fx.math.fma(win[3][e], wf[e * 4 + 3], a)
                        ys.append(_silu(a))
                    win = win[1:]
                    ov = Vec.from_elements(ys, dtype=fx.Float32).to(fx.BFloat16).bitcast(fx.Int32).ir_value()
                    if oks is None:
                        buffer_ops.buffer_store(ov, out_r, obase + t * os0)
                    else:
                        okt = oks[t]
                        if okt:
                            buffer_ops.buffer_store(ov, out_r, obase + t * os0)

            is_head = g < n_seqs
            if is_head:
                # head block of sequence s = g: its first min(3, seqlen) tokens and the conv_state writeback
                s = g
                cs_start = fx.Int32(buffer_ops.buffer_load(cu_r, s, vec_width=1, dtype=i32))
                cs_end = fx.Int32(buffer_ops.buffer_load(cu_r, s + 1, vec_width=1, dtype=i32))
                seqlen = cs_end - cs_start
                if seqlen > 0:
                    wf = _wf()
                    slot = fx.Int32(buffer_ops.buffer_load(si_r, s, vec_width=1, dtype=i32))
                    hi8 = fx.Int8(buffer_ops.buffer_load(hi_r, s, vec_width=1, dtype=T.i8))
                    hi_nz = hi8 != 0
                    cs_base = slot * scs0 + c_glob_h
                    xbase = cs_start * sx0 + pbase
                    zero_v = _arith.ConstantOp(_v4t, ir.DenseElementsAttr.get_splat(
                        _v4t, ir.IntegerAttr.get(_i32t, 0))).result
                    raws = []
                    oks = []
                    for r in fx.range_constexpr(SL):
                        okr = fx.Int32(r) < seqlen
                        oks.append(okr)
                        raws.append(buffer_ops.buffer_load(x_r, okr.select(xbase + r * sx0, xbase), vec_width=4, dtype=i32))
                    heads = []
                    for r in fx.range_constexpr(SL):
                        hs = buffer_ops.buffer_load(cs_r, cs_base + r * scs1, vec_width=4, dtype=i32)
                        heads.append(_sel(hi_nz, hs, zero_v))
                    _tokens(wf, heads, raws, SL, cs_start * os0 + c_in_part_h, oks)
                    # ---- state writeback: window positions seqlen .. seqlen+2
                    for i in fx.range_constexpr(SL):
                        wpos = seqlen + i
                        from_x = wpos >= SL
                        offx = from_x.select(xbase + (wpos - SL) * sx0, xbase)
                        xv = buffer_ops.buffer_load(x_r, offx, vec_width=4, dtype=i32)
                        hv = heads[0]
                        hv = _sel(wpos == 1, heads[1], hv)
                        hv = _sel(wpos == 2, heads[2], hv)
                        nv = _sel(from_x, xv, hv)
                        buffer_ops.buffer_store(nv, cs_r, cs_base + i * scs1)
            else:
                # body block: global tokens t0 .. t0+BT-1; stores skip each sequence's first 3 tokens (head blocks own them)
                t0 = (g - n_seqs) * BT
                cus = []
                for i in fx.range_constexpr(MAXS + 1):
                    idx = (n_seqs < i).select(n_seqs, fx.Int32(i)) if i > 0 else fx.Int32(0)
                    cus.append(fx.Int32(buffer_ops.buffer_load(cu_r, idx, vec_width=1, dtype=i32)))
                rows = []
                for r in fx.range_constexpr(-SL, BT):
                    tr = t0 + r
                    tr = (tr < 0).select(fx.Int32(0), tr)
                    tr = (tr >= n_tok).select(n_tok - 1, tr)
                    rows.append(buffer_ops.buffer_load(x_r, tr * sx0 + pbase, vec_width=4, dtype=i32))
                wf = _wf()
                cu0 = cus[0]
                cun = cus[MAXS]
                nh = fx.Int32(0)
                for i in fx.range_constexpr(MAXS):
                    hit = (fx.Int32(i) < n_seqs) & (cus[i] >= t0 - 2) & (cus[i] <= t0 + (BT - 1))
                    nh = nh + hit.select(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0))
                clean = (nh == 0) & (t0 >= cu0) & ((t0 + BT) <= cun)
                obase = t0 * os0 + c_in_part_h
                if clean:
                    _tokens(wf, rows[0:SL], rows[SL:], BT, obase, None)
                else:
                    oks = []
                    for t in fx.range_constexpr(BT):
                        tt = t0 + t
                        nt = fx.Int32(0)
                        for i in fx.range_constexpr(MAXS):
                            hit = (fx.Int32(i) < n_seqs) & (cus[i] >= tt - 2) & (cus[i] <= tt)
                            nt = nt + hit.select(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0))
                        oks.append((nt == 0) & (tt >= cu0) & (tt < cun))
                    _tokens(wf, rows[0:SL], rows[SL:], BT, obase, oks)

    @flyc.jit
    def launch(
        x_ptr: fx.Tensor,
        w_ptr: fx.Tensor,
        cs_ptr: fx.Tensor,
        si_ptr: fx.Tensor,
        hi_ptr: fx.Tensor,
        cu_ptr: fx.Tensor,
        q_ptr: fx.Tensor,
        k_ptr: fx.Tensor,
        v_ptr: fx.Tensor,
        n_seqs: Int32,
        proj_h: Int32,
        sx0: Int32,
        sx1: Int32,
        scs0: Int32,
        scs1: Int32,
        qs0: Int32,
        ks0: Int32,
        vs0: Int32,
        n_tok: Int32,
        gx: Int32,
        gy: Int32,
        stream: fx.Stream,
    ):
        conv_kernel(
            x_ptr, w_ptr, cs_ptr, si_ptr, hi_ptr, cu_ptr, q_ptr, k_ptr, v_ptr,
            n_seqs, proj_h, sx0, sx1, scs0, scs1, qs0, ks0, vs0, n_tok,
        ).launch(grid=(fx.Int64(gx), fx.Int64(gy), 1), block=(LANES, 1, 1), stream=stream)

    return launch


def run(*, x, weight, conv_state, state_indices, has_initial_state, cu_seqlens, storage, q, k, v):
    n_tokens, _, proj = x.shape
    n_seqs = state_indices.shape[0]
    assert proj % STRIP == 0
    gx = (n_tokens + BT - 1) // BT + n_seqs
    gy = 3 * (proj // STRIP)
    # flat 1-D views (no copy): the kernel addresses them with the strides passed below
    xf = torch.as_strided(x, ((n_tokens - 1) * x.stride(0) + 3 * proj,), (1,))
    n_slots = conv_state.shape[0]
    csf = torch.as_strided(conv_state, ((n_slots - 1) * conv_state.stride(0) + 3 * conv_state.stride(1),), (1,))
    _launcher(n_seqs > MAXS)(
        xf, weight, csf, state_indices, has_initial_state, cu_seqlens, q, k, v,
        int(n_seqs), proj // 2,
        x.stride(0) // 2, x.stride(1) // 2,
        conv_state.stride(0) // 2, conv_state.stride(1) // 2,
        q.stride(0) // 2, k.stride(0) // 2, v.stride(0) // 2, int(n_tokens),
        int(gx), int(gy), torch.cuda.current_stream(),
    )


def warm_up(device):
    proj = 1536
    n = 8192
    x = torch.zeros(n, 3, proj, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
    w = torch.zeros(3 * proj, 4, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
    cs = torch.zeros(2, 3, 3 * proj, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
    q = torch.empty(n, proj, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
    k = torch.empty_like(q)
    v = torch.empty_like(q)
    # both variants: the unrolled search (n_seqs <= MAXS) and the binary search (more sequences)
    for ns in (1, MAXS + 1):
        si = torch.zeros(ns, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
        hi = torch.zeros(ns, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
        cu = torch.arange(ns + 1, dtype=torch.int32, device=device) * (n // ns)
        cu[-1] = n
        run(x=x, weight=w, conv_state=cs, state_indices=si, has_initial_state=hi, cu_seqlens=cu, storage=None,
            q=q, k=k, v=v)
